company.name: RevenueBase
company.shortDescription: RevenueBase is a provider of the database as a service intended to serve B2B companies.
company.description:
RevenueBase provides a revenue database as a service that delivers the data completeness and accuracy at scale to easily and successfully reach and engage with prospects.

Business executives can obtain more and better data that can be promptly translated into revenue development thanks to the company's analysis of clients' go-to-market opportunities and delivery of the right account and contact information through an up-to-date, simple-to-manage database.

RevenueBase was established on May 1, 2021 in Waltham, Massachusetts by Mark J. Feldman and Milenko Beslic.

productsAndServices.description: A continuously verified and enriched database of global B2B company and contact information designed to support sales and marketing outreach.
productsAndServices.name: RevenueBase B2B Database

productsAndServices.description: An email verification service tailored for B2B data that ensures high accuracy, including catch-all and firewall-protected domains, to improve email deliverability.
productsAndServices.name: RevenueBase Email Verification

productsAndServices.description: A data delivery solution that provides customers with full, unrestricted access to the entire RevenueBase dataset through a spreadsheet-like interface for easy exploration and export.
productsAndServices.name: RevenueBase Data Delivery via Gigasheet

productsAndServices.description: Consultative guidance and resources to help organizations establish and maintain data governance policies and frameworks for managing B2B data quality and compliance.
productsAndServices.name: RevenueBase Data Governance Framework Guidance

productsAndServices.description: A partnership service that enables companies to integrate and resell RevenueBase’s B2B data to enhance their own products and offerings.
productsAndServices.name: RevenueBase Partner Program

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $6,000,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $27,901,218 to $27,901,218, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 56 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (+0).
